episodes.name: The First Commandment
episodes.overview: SG-1 must stop a renegade Stargate commander, who has gone mad and set himself up as a god on an alien planet.

episodes.name: Cold Lazarus
episodes.overview: During an off-world assignment, Jack is struck down by energy from a blue crystal... which creates a duplicate of him that returns to Earth in Jack's place.

episodes.name: The Nox
episodes.overview: Pressed by the government to acquire new technologies, SG-1 is led to a world inhabited by a seemingly primative race. When Apophis arrives, SG-1 ambush him with disasterous consequences.

episodes.name: Brief Candle
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers a race of attractive people who age extremely rapidly. The situation becomes personal when O'Neill begins to suffer from the same accelerated aging, and must live out the rest of his life on the planet.

episodes.name: Thor's Hammer
episodes.overview: Teal'c and O'Neill are transported to an underground cage designed by the Asgard to protect an alien world from the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: The Torment of Tantalus
episodes.overview: SG-1 tracks down Catherine Langford's fiancee, who took the first Stargate trip in 1945, and discovers an ancient meeting hall that may hold the secrets of the universe itself.

episodes.name: Bloodlines
episodes.overview: Teal'c returns to Chulak to stop his people from implanting his son with a larval Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Fire and Water
episodes.overview: Daniel is taken captive by an alien with a hidden agenda, while SG-1 is made to believe he is dead.

episodes.name: Hathor
episodes.overview: The banished Goa'uld Hathor is found in an ancient sarcophagus Earth, and takes over the S.G.C. with hopes of raising a new army against the System Lords.

episodes.name: Singularity
episodes.overview: A mysterious affliction wipes out the entire population of a planet, plus an SG team -- except for one young girl. Carter befriends her, but learns that she is being used by the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Cor-Ai
episodes.overview: Teal'c must stand trial for a crime committed while he served as first prime of Apophis when a villager on an alien world identifies him as the Jaffa who killed his father.

episodes.name: Enigma
episodes.overview: The SG-1 team rescues a group of advanced humans from a planet near destruction, and must find a new home for the refugees before the Pentagon gets their hands on them.

episodes.name: Solitudes
episodes.overview: Colonel O'Neill and Captain Carter are separated from Jackson and Teal'c during a Stargate journey, and are trapped on a desolate ice world with no way of escape.

episodes.name: Tin Man
episodes.overview: The members of SG-1 arrive on P3X-989 and are knocked unconscious. They wake up and return to Earth only to find that they are not quite themselves.

episodes.name: There But For the Grace of God
episodes.overview: An alien artifact transports Daniel to an alternate reality, where he is not a part of the Stargate program and the Goa'uld -- led by Teal'c -- are invading Earth.

episodes.name: Politics (1)
episodes.overview: Senator Kinsey arrives at the SGC to investigate the program and determine whether the great drain on the U.S. budget is worthwhile, prompting the team to recall missions from the past year.

episodes.name: Within the Serpent's Grasp (2)
episodes.overview: SG-1 escapes through the Stargate before it is shut down, and learns that Daniel's alternate reality vision is true: Apophis is moving to attack Earth from above. The team must stop Apophis and his son, Klorel, who inhabits the body of their friend Skaara.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: O'Neill and the team return to Cimmeria, the planet where they destroyed Thor's Hammer to help Teal'c escape. They find that the Goa'uld have invaded and many of the people are dead. Can they help to find Thor's weapons to fight off the invasion before they are all captured or killed?

episodes.name: The Serpent's Lair (3)
episodes.overview: With SG-1 trapped on Klorel's ship, it seems that Earth is doomed as the Pyramid Ships prepare to destroy Earth.

episodes.name: In the Line of Duty
episodes.overview: Carter is possessed by a Goa'uld who claims to be an enemy of the System Lords.

episodes.name: Prisoners
episodes.overview: SG-1 is put on trial and exiled to a prison world, where a woman maintains a strange control over her fellow prisoners.

episodes.name: The Gamekeeper
episodes.overview: SG-1 is imprisoned in a virtual reality realm and forced to relive the worst moments of their lives over and over.

episodes.name: Need
episodes.overview: Jackson becomes addicted to the effects of a Goa'uld sarcophagus, and falls for the planet's manipulative princess.

episodes.name: Thor's Chariot
episodes.overview: SG-1 returns to Cimmeria, and finds that without protection from the Asgard the planet has been invaded by the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Message in a Bottle
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers an ancient artifact that takes O'Neill and the S.G.C. hostage.

episodes.name: Family
episodes.overview: The SG-1 team attempt to rescue Teal'c's son, who has been kidnapped and brainwashed by Apophis. Teal'c learns disturbing news about his wife.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Jackson discovers that his wife has returned to Abydos, and is nine months pregnant with the son of Apophis. O'Neill must keep the secret of the Stargate program from being uncovered.

episodes.name: Bane
episodes.overview: Teal'c is infected with deadly venom from a giant insect, and begins a terrible transformation. When he escapes the S.G.C., SG-1 must find him before Colonel Maybourne does.

episodes.name: The Tok'ra (1)
episodes.overview: SG-1 locates the Tok'ra, a Goa'uld resistance movement who oppose the System Lords, and attempt to form an alliance. Jacob Carter's cancer brings him near death.

episodes.name: The Tok'ra (2)
episodes.overview: While SG-1 tries to form an alliance with the Tok'ra, a spy betrays the rebels to the Goa'uld. Jacob Carter finds that the Tok'ra may be his only hope of survival

episodes.name: Spirits
episodes.overview: SG-1 finds a planet inhabited by Native American Indians, protected by spirits who are actually advanced alien shapeshifters.

episodes.name: Touchstone
episodes.overview: SG-1 is accused of stealing an important weather-controlling device, sending a primative planet into chaos. The team discovers that Earth's second Stargate is being misused.

episodes.name: The Fifth Race
episodes.overview: O'Neill becomes the unwilling receptacle for a library of alien knowledge.

episodes.name: A Matter of Time
episodes.overview: After gating to a world on the edge of a black hole, the S.G.C. cannot disengage the Stargate. All of Earth becomes endangered by the time-distorting gravity field.

episodes.name: Holiday
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers an elderly man known for developing technology to fight the Goa'uld. Daniel is tricked into switching bodies with the man, Ma'chello, who believes he is "owed" for all the good he has done.

episodes.name: Serpent's Song
episodes.overview: Apophis, SG-1's greatest enemy, seeks sanctuary from Sokar and ends up near death in the S.G.C. infirmary.

episodes.name: One False Step
episodes.overview: A group of primitive aliens begin to fall deathly ill after SG-1 arrives.

episodes.name: Show and Tell
episodes.overview: A young boy arrives through the Stargate, and warns of plot by invisible aliens to kill all of the human race in order to rob the Goa'uld of potential hosts.
A cosmic accident causes SG-1 to be sent back 30 years into Earth's past, where they must locate the Stargate and find a way home.

episodes.name: Out of Mind (1)
episodes.overview: O'Neill, Carter and Jackson awaken from stasis in what appears to be the S.G.C. -- almost 80 years in the future.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: SG-1 in their fight against the Goa'uld Empire's System Lords, the main being Sokar until "The Devil You Know" and then Apophis, after he regained power during that episode.

episodes.name: Into the Fire (2)
episodes.overview: O'Neill, Carter and Jackson must escape Hathor's clutches, while Teal'c tries to raise a Jaffa army on Chulak. General Hammond must take desperate measures to rescue the team.

episodes.name: Seth
episodes.overview: SG-1 must find a renegade Goa'uld who has been hiding on Earth for thousands of years.

episodes.name: Fair Game
episodes.overview: The Asgard aid Earth in negotiating a nonagression treaty with the Goa'uld System Lords.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.overview: When Daniel goes insane, SG-1 must deal with the legacy of Machello's anti-Goa'uld technology.

episodes.name: Learning Curve
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers a planet where children are used to acquire knowledge for the entire population, then discarded.

episodes.name: Point of View
episodes.overview: SG-1 must free an alternate reality Earth from a Goa'uld invasion after duplicates of Samantha Carter and Charles Kawalsky come through the quantum mirror.

episodes.name: Deadman Switch
episodes.overview: SG-1 is taken captive by an alien bounty hunter with uncertain loyalties.

episodes.name: Demons
episodes.overview: SG-1 finds a medieval Christian society terrorized by Sokar and the Unas, and is accused of being possessed by demons.

episodes.name: Rules of Engagement
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers a military camp where young men are trained to impersonate SGC personnel to infiltrate Earth.

episodes.name: Forever in a Day
episodes.overview: Jackson deals with the apparent death of his wife, Sha're, at the hands of Teal'c.

episodes.name: Past and Present
episodes.overview: SG-1 encounters an entire planet suffering from amnesia.  The planet's leader returns to Earth with SG-1 to find a cure,  but SG-1 suspects she may not be who she appears to be.

episodes.name: Jolinar's Memories (1)
episodes.overview: When Major Carter's father Jacob is kidnapped by Sokar, the SG-1 team must infiltrate a prison moon designed to look like hell to rescue him.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know (2)
episodes.overview: SG-1 must escape a hellish prison moon, and one of their worst enemies.

episodes.name: Foothold
episodes.overview: SG-1 returns from a mission and discovers that metamorphic aliens have taken over the complex.

episodes.name: Pretense
episodes.overview: The Tollan put Skaara and Klorel on trial to determine who will control the host body.

episodes.name: Urgo
episodes.overview: SG-1 receives alien brain implants that manifest themselves as a bizarre man, who tells them that they would not survive the procedure to remove him.

episodes.name: A Hundred Days
episodes.overview: After a meteor strike buries the Stargate, O'Neill finds himself stranded on a planet with no hope of rescue.

episodes.name: Shades of Grey
episodes.overview: O'Neill steals technology from the Tollan, and is forced to leave the Stargate program. Maybourne offers an intriguing proposal.

episodes.name: New Ground
episodes.overview: The members of SG-1 are imprisoned on a planet and become pawns in a war of ideology.

episodes.name: Maternal Instinct
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers the mystical planet Kheb, and must find the Harcesis child of Apophis and Sha're before Apophis's army does.

episodes.name: Crystal Skull
episodes.overview: An alien artifact causes Daniel to disappear, and the team looks for help from his institutionalized grandfather.

episodes.name: Nemesis (1)
episodes.overview: SG-1 faces creatures of mass destruction that even the Asgard can't control, and must destroy Thor's infested vessel before the Replicator bugs reach Earth.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: O'Neill and Teal'c risk their lives to keep the Replicator bugs from gaining a foothold on Earth, while Carter helps the Asgard fend off a Replicator invasion. A warring alien race offers to exchange their advanced technology for Earth's help in defeating their enemy.

episodes.name: Small Victories (2)
episodes.overview: O'Neill and Teal'c risk their lives to keep the Replicator bugs from gaining a foothold on Earth, while Carter helps the Asgard fend off a Replicator invasion.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: A warring alien race offers to exchange their advanced technology for Earth's help in defeating their enemy.

episodes.name: Upgrades
episodes.overview: A Tok'ra archaeologist arrives at the SGC with newly discovered technology, giving the SG-1 team superhuman powers.

episodes.name: Crossroads
episodes.overview: Teal'c is reunited with his lost love -- a woman who claims to have found a way to communicate with her symbiote and defeat the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Divide and Conquer
episodes.overview: When a member of the SGC tries to kill a Tok'ra, it is revealed that O'Neill and Carter may be victims of an untraceable form of Goa'uld mind control.

episodes.name: Window of Opportunity
episodes.overview: O'Neill and Teal'c are caught in a time loop in the SGC, and must relive the same 10 hours over and over again.

episodes.name: Watergate
episodes.overview: The Russians recover a Stargate from the bottom of the ocean, and turn to the SGC for help when their experiments go awry.

episodes.name: The First Ones
episodes.overview: Dr. Jackson is taken captive by an Unas while on an archaeological dig. The SGC mounts a rescue operation, but discovers a danger of their own.

episodes.name: Scorched Earth
episodes.overview: SG-1 is caught in a conflict between two civilizations trying to colonize the same planet.

episodes.name: Beneath the Surface
episodes.overview: The members of SG-1 are used as forced labor in an underground alien facility after their memories are erased by the ruling elite.

episodes.name: Point of No Return
episodes.overview: SG-1 investigates a conspiracy theorist who has detailed knowledge of the Stargate program.

episodes.name: Tangent
episodes.overview: A test gone wrong leaves Jack and Teal'c marooned in space aboard a damaged prototype attack ship

episodes.name: The Curse
episodes.overview: When his former mentor dies, Dr. Jackson returns to his roots -- and discovers an ancient Egyptian artifact containing a Goa'uld parasite.

episodes.name: The Serpent's Venom
episodes.overview: SG-1 must stop Apophis and Heru-ur from forming an alliance of their powerful forces, while Teal'c is captured and tortured by the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Chain Reaction
episodes.overview: SG-1 must adjust to a new commanding officer when General Hammond steps down -- but O'Neill discovers foul play behind the general's resignation.
Ten years into the future, the former members of SG-1 must send a message into the past to prevent the extinction of the human race.

episodes.name: Absolute Power
episodes.overview: Jackson's teammates notice a disturbing change in him when he is reunited with the Harcesis child and given the Goa'uld genetic memory.

episodes.name: The Light
episodes.overview: SG-1 finds a deserted Goa'uld palace, where a beautiful device causes suicidal tendencies.

episodes.name: Prodigy
episodes.overview: Carter must help keep a promising young cadet from throwing away a future at the SGC. O'Neill and Teal'c encounter a dangerous life form at an offworld research base.

episodes.name: Entity
episodes.overview: The SGC is invaded by an alien life force that takes up residence in the base computer system -- and in Major Carter.

episodes.name: Double Jeopardy
episodes.overview: SG-1 must rescue an alien world from the Goa'uld -- with help from an unexpected source. Teal'c seeks revenge on the System Lord Cronus for the murder of his father.

episodes.name: Exodus (1)
episodes.overview: SG-1 helps to evacuate the Tok'ra to a new base -- but matters are complicated when a spy reveals their location to Apophis. The team attempts a daring plan to take out the Goa'uld's powerful fleet.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: SG-1 trains a team of raw cadets, and Colonel O'Neill is forced to take them into a real-life battle situation when he learns of a possible alien incursion at the S.G.C. After an accident with the Stargate traps Teal'c in transit, SG-1 must turn to Russia – and to their enemies – for help before time runs out.

episodes.name: Enemies (2)
episodes.overview: SG-1 finds themselves stranded in a crippled ship in a distant galaxy -- with Apophis threatening to destroy them. Teal'c is brainwashed and made loyal to Apophis once again.

episodes.name: Threshold (3)
episodes.overview: His mind altered by Apophis, Teal'c must undergo a ritual that takes him to the edge of death itself, in order for him to rediscover who he is.

episodes.name: Ascension
episodes.overview: An alien being is smitten with Carter and follows her back to Earth. It assumes a human form and pursues a relationship with her.

episodes.name: The Fifth Man
episodes.overview: O'Neill and Lieutenant Tyler are ambushed by Goa'uld forces and trapped behind enemy lines -- while the rest of their team discover they don't know who Tyler is.

episodes.name: Red Sky
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers that their recent trip through the Stargate may have inadvertently doomed an entire civilization.

episodes.name: Rite of Passage
episodes.overview: Cassandra mysteriously falls ill, sending SG-1 back to her home planet -- where they uncover a dark Goa'uld secret.

episodes.name: Beast of Burden
episodes.overview: SG-1 discovers a civilization that uses Unas as slave labor, and attempt to liberate Daniel's friend, Chaka.

episodes.name: The Tomb
episodes.overview: SG-1 teams with a Russian unit when one of their Stargate teams goes missing in a mysterious alien ziggurat.

episodes.name: Between Two Fires
episodes.overview: The Tollan offer Earth advanced weapons technology, prompting a secret investigation on Tollana -- one that leads to a startling discovery.
SG-1 encounters a potential new, technologically advanced ally in the war against the Goa'uld -- though they do not know the Aschen's dark secret.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.overview: When Carter goes missing, O'Neill teams up with Col. Maybourne again to free her.

episodes.name: Wormhole X-Treme!
episodes.overview: An alien ship approaches Earth, sending SG-1 to an old friend for some answers -- where they discover that Martin Lloyd has created a TV show about the Stargate program.

episodes.name: Proving Ground
episodes.overview: SG-1 trains a team of raw cadets, and Colonel O'Neill is forced to take them into a real-life battle situation when he learns of a possible alien incursion at the SGC.

episodes.name: 48 Hours
episodes.overview: Disaster strikes the Stargate, trapping Teal'c in transit. SG-1 must turn to Russia -- and to their enemies -- for help.

episodes.name: Summit (1)
episodes.overview: The Tok'ra war with the Goa'uld escalates, and the rebel faction sends Daniel Jackson to a secret meeting between the System Lords.

episodes.name: Last Stand (2)
episodes.overview: Dr. Jackson's undercover mission to a Goa'uld summit is complicated by the arrival of a surprise guest. The rest of the team face a full-scale invasion of the Tok'ra homeworld.

episodes.name: Fail Safe
episodes.overview: Earth finds itself threatened by something even larger than the Goa'uld when the team learns that an asteroid is on a collision course with the planet.

episodes.name: The Warrior
episodes.overview: A charismatic Jaffa leader seeks to forge an alliance between Earth and his rebel followers, winning the allegiance of Teal'c and Bra'tac.

episodes.name: Menace
episodes.overview: SG-1 encounters a young woman with the ability to control Replicators, and who may hold the key to the salvation of the Asgard.

episodes.name: The Sentinel
episodes.overview: SG-1 must turn to a pair of convicted criminals to save a world from annihilation by the Goa'uld.

episodes.name: Meridian
episodes.overview: Daniel Jackson is exposed to a lethal dose of radiation while visiting an alien civilization that is building a weapon of mass destruction.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.overview: SG-1 must come to the rescue of their once-powerful allies when the Goa'uld attack a secret Asgard laboratory.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: O'Neill and Carter launch a risky plan with untested technology when Earth comes under attack by the Goa'uld. Carter must find a way to save Earth from total destruction at the hands of the Goa'uld, who have turned the Stargate into a doomsday bomb. Rya'c joins his father on a mission to destroy the Goa'uld weapon.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: SG-1 discovers Daniel Jackson alive and living on an alien world, with no memory of who he is. The team hatches a plan to lure Anubis into a trap and destroy his new super-weapon. The team returns to Jonas's homeworld when they learn that the Goa'uld are after its naquadria.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: With Jack still in stasis in the Ancient outpost buried in Antarctica, SG-1 tries to contact the Asgard. Meanwhile their new leader, Dr. Elizabeth Weir, tries to decide what to do about a request for peace talks from the Goa'uld System Lords.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: As one team member transitions into a new role, another is met with hesitation in season nine. Having learned of the Ori's plan to control the mortal plane, the team must find Merlin's secret weapon that may destroy the Ori and ensure the safety of Earth.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview:
As the team embarks upon its tenth year, Vala, a former Goa'uld host turned freedom-fighter, joins SG-1 in their battle to defend the galaxy from the holy war of the Ori. Having discovered the existence of a weapon capable of defeating the Ori, the team is now in a race against time to find it before more systems fall to the influence of the Priors and the threat of the newly arrived Origin fleet.  

The season is continued with direct-to-DVD film Stargate: The Ark of Truth.

media.title: Stargate Atlantis
media.overview: With the Ancients' city of Atlantis discovered in the Pegasus Galaxy by Stargate Command, Dr. Elizabeth Weir and Major Sheppard lead a scientific expedition to the ancient abandoned city. Once there, the team not only find themselves unable to contact Earth, but their explorations unexpectedly reawaken the Ancients' deadly enemies, The Wraith, who hunger for this new prey. Now with the help of newfound local allies like Teyla Emmagan, the Atlantis Team sets about to uncover their new home's secrets even as their war of survival against the Wraith begins.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The Atlantis expedition team, led by Dr. Elizabeth Weir, arrives in the Pegasus Galaxy and discovers the lost city of Atlantis. They encounter a powerful new enemy, the Wraith, and face various challenges to protect their new home while exploring the galaxy and seeking new allies.

episodes.name: Rising (1)
episodes.overview: A new Stargate team embarks on a dangerous mission to a distant galaxy, where they discover a mythical lost city -- and a deadly new enemy.

episodes.name: Rising (2)
episodes.overview: Sheppard tries to convince Weir to mount a rescue mission to free Colonel Sumner, Teyla, and the others captured by the Wraith.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: The Atlantis base is threatened when the team discovers that an alien entity is in the city. McKay's experiment with alien technology goes awry.

episodes.name: Thirty Eight Minutes
episodes.overview: The team finds themselves in mortal danger when their Puddle Jumper ship becomes lodged in the Stargate.

episodes.name: Suspicion
episodes.overview: After a series of run-ins with the Wraith, the team begins to suspect their Athosian allies of having a spy in their midst.

episodes.name: Childhood's End
episodes.overview: Sheppard and the team visit a world where no one is over 24 years old -- because of a ritual suicide practice they believe keeps the Wraith at bay.

episodes.name: Poisoning the Well
episodes.overview: The team finds a world whose people are on the brink of a discovery that may make them immune to the Wraith feeding.

episodes.name: Underground
episodes.overview: Efforts to open trade relations with a species called the Genii turn sour when the team discovers their new "allies" have ulterior motives.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: McKay's efforts to harness the energy of an alien planet's atmosphere allows for a return trip to Earth -- but the team may not be able to return to Atlantis.

episodes.name: The Storm (1)
episodes.overview: When a massive storm threatens the city, Atlantis is evacuated, only to be taken over by the team's newest enemy.

episodes.name: The Eye (2)
episodes.overview: Major Sheppard plays a dangerous game of cat and mouse with soldiers who have seized control of Atlantis and taken Weir and McKay hostage.

episodes.name: The Defiant One
episodes.overview: Sheppard's team investigates a downed Wraith ship, and find themselves stuck on a planet with a lone Wraith survivor.

episodes.name: Hot Zone
episodes.overview: Nearly a third of Atlantis's residents are infected with a deadly virus that causes hallucinations and death, forcing a lockdown of the city.

episodes.name: Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The team finds a paradise world that would make an ideal sanctuary for those fleeing from the Wraith, but the local inhabitants believe their goddess will not permit it.

episodes.name: Before I Sleep
episodes.overview: A woman is found in suspended animation in Atlantis, and the team is shocked to see that it is Dr. Weir herself, who tells them of her trip 10,000 years into the city's past.

episodes.name: The Brotherhood
episodes.overview: The team searches for a valuable Zero Point Module rumored to be hidden on the planet Dagan. But their new allies have motives of their own.

episodes.name: Letters From Pegasus
episodes.overview: Given a brief opportunity to send a data transmission to Earth, members of the Atlantis expedition compose video messages home to their loved ones.

episodes.name: The Gift
episodes.overview: Plagued by terrifying nightmares, Teyla begins to recall a time when she and her father were captured by the Wraith and subjected to disturbing experiments.

episodes.name: The Siege (1)
episodes.overview: With a group of Wraith hive ships on the way to Atlantis, the team searches for a place to flee and a way to destroy the city. McKay leads a team to try and activate the Ancients' orbital weapons platform.

episodes.name: The Siege (2)
episodes.overview: All hope seems lost, until Colonel Everett arrives suddenly from Earth. He is determined to defend the city until the arrival of a ZPM, brought by a new ship.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As the Wraith threat intensifies, the team strives to find ways to defend Atlantis and the Pegasus Galaxy from impending invasion. Key episodes focus on breakthroughs in ancient technology, dangerous alliances, and a desperate search for a means to stop their enemies once and for all.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The team faces escalating conflicts with both old and new adversaries, including the Wraith and a deadly new faction. The discovery of a potential game-changing technology introduces new ethical dilemmas, while relationships within the team are tested under growing pressures.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With changes in leadership and new allies, the team continues to battle the Wraith and confront new existential threats. Personal dynamics shift as members struggle with loss and make significant choices that shape the fate of Atlantis and its mission in the Pegasus Galaxy.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: As Atlantis faces its greatest threats yet, the team must rely on unexpected alliances and new technologies to safeguard their city and the galaxy. The season builds toward a climactic confrontation that tests the strength, ingenuity, and resolve of the entire expedition.

media.title: Attack on Titan
media.overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Centuries ago, mankind was slaughtered to near extinction by monstrous humanoid creatures called titans, forcing humans to hide in fear behind enormous concentric walls. What makes these giants truly terrifying is that their taste for human flesh is not born out of hunger but what appears to be out of pleasure. To ensure their survival, the remnants of humanity began living within defensive barriers, resulting in one hundred years without a single titan encounter. However, that fragile calm is soon shattered when a colossal titan manages to breach the supposedly impregnable outer wall, reigniting the fight for survival against the man-eating abominations.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Eren’s battle against the Titans rages on! After fighting the Female Titan, he has no time to rest as a hoard approaches Wall Rose. A new war begins and as they face the threat to humanity, they begin to unearth terrifying secrets. What are the Titans really and where do they get their power—and who’s really on their side?

episodes.name: Beast Titan
episodes.overview: Coupled with the military's cover-up of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the Walls causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

episodes.name: I'm Home
episodes.overview: With the appearance of Titans within Wall Rose, Sasha and Connie ride as messengers to warn their villages of the impending threat.

episodes.name: Southwestward
episodes.overview: The Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and the others learn that someone close may be hiding all the answers.

episodes.name: Soldier
episodes.overview: Unarmed and overwhelmed by the Titan assault on the castle, the only hope for the Scouts may lie in a promise and a secret.

episodes.name: Historia
episodes.overview: Utgard Castle comes crumbling down as Ymir desperately battles the Titans. Now, Christa must fulfill the promise they made long ago during winter training.

episodes.name: Warrior
episodes.overview: Following the battle, the Scouts regroup atop the wall only to find more questions than answers.

episodes.name: Close Combat
episodes.overview: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal.

episodes.name: The Hunters
episodes.overview: Without a way to pursue the Titans, the Scouts have no choice but to recuperate as they wait for reinforcements. But do they still have faith in Eren?

episodes.name: Opening
episodes.overview: The Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, but Reiner is not quite himself while the group is trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

episodes.name: Children
episodes.overview: When their group finally flees, Ymir wonders whether she should lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

episodes.name: Charge
episodes.overview: The pursuit begins as the Recon Corps battles their way to Eren. But as the Scouts start to take numerous casualties, Erwin executes a risky strategy.

episodes.name: Scream
episodes.overview: The battle continues as Eren and the Scouts face many hard decisions. Who is the real enemy? What is the war really about? And what will the future hold for mankind?

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The truth about the Titans begins to come to light. Political secrets, a false king, and the reality that will shake the foundation of the world—all falls on the shoulders of Eren and his friends, as they fight to survive. With Historia set to be the rightful Queen, the Levi Squad must act. But a figure from Levi’s past, the deadly Kenny, could turn this into a losing battle. Are Eren and his friends prepared to face the true monsters that lie within the walls?

seasons.name: The Final Season
seasons.overview: The truth revealed through the memories of Grisha's journals shakes all of Eren's deepest beliefs. There is no rugged but free land beyond the walls. There is a whole other world, equally full of oppression and war. Suddenly, the ambitions that have animated the Survey Corps for generations seem small and naive. What is there left to fight for?

media.title: Back to the Future
media.overview: Eighties teenager Marty McFly is accidentally sent back in time to 1955, inadvertently disrupting his parents' first meeting and attracting his mother's romantic interest. Marty must repair the damage to history by rekindling his parents' romance and - with the help of his eccentric inventor friend Doc Brown - return to 1985.
